一句话作用: Submit compact NCBI PMC Open Access requests for article/file availability metadata. Use when a user wants concise PMC Open Access summaries; save raw XML only on request.
关键输入: - Read one JSON object from stdin. - Optional fields: params, record path, max items, max depth, timeout sec, save raw, raw output path - Common PMC Open Access patterns: - {"params":{"id":"PMC3257301"},"max items":10} - {"params":{"id":"10.1093/nar/gkr1184"}…
关键输出: - Success returns ok, source, and a compact summary. - Use raw output path when save raw=true. - Failure returns ok=false with error.code and error.message.
